name: Verdurous-Polje
description: Water rules this world utterly, kilometers deep over drowned continents. Swells march in orderly regiments until they shatter against frozen methane lakes, and the spray smells of minerals and cold salt.

Standing still, you feel the frozen air press in like a verdict. Wind is the only voice here, and it repeats itself. The only confirmed life is microbial, a chemosynthetic film that glows faintly where the ground weeps warmth.
Instruments disagree about the temporal distortion zone: mass reads one value, inertia another. Probes sent in return transmitting their own launch signals, timestamped hours early.
Whoever solves this anomaly will rewrite several sciences. Whoever blunders into it will merely end several careers.
